# Static checks for the GitHub settings stack. It holds no cloud credential and no GitHub token
# beyond read access: only the owner plans and applies this stack, locally (ADR-0010).
# policies/check-workflow.sh fails the build if this file ever gains a credential, an OIDC
# permission or a plan or apply command.
name: github-config

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'foundation/github/**'
      - '.github/workflows/github-config.yml'
      - 'mise.toml'

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: github-config-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  MISE_VERSION: 2026.11.14

jobs:
  static:
    name: static
    runs-on: ${{ github.run_attempt != 1 && vars.CI_FALLBACK || fromJSON(vars.CI_RUNNER || '"ubuntu-latest"') }}
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: jdx/mise-action@924e7c586e33d7d4bae9c14e26c5d22e2beb6e78 # v5.3.0
        with:
          version: ${{ env.MISE_VERSION }}
          cache: ${{ runner.environment == 'github-hosted' }}
      - run: mise run github:check
        env:
          # tflint downloads its ruleset from GitHub; the read-only token avoids the shared-IP rate limit.
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
